claims.statement: Inside a mathematical time loop, almost every digital lock would break at once except a one-time secret pad.
In known physics, no quantum trick, analog circuit, or reported anomaly sends readable answers backward in time.
Every fast lookup of a future answer is work paid upfront, which fresh random values defeat immediately.

easy_read.easy_title: Why Nobody Can Look Up Tomorrow
three_points_one_idea_sentences: This study is about why nobody can look up tomorrow.
Inside a mathematical time loop, almost every digital lock would break at once except a one-time secret pad.
In known physics, no quantum trick, analog circuit, or reported anomaly sends readable answers backward in time.
Every fast lookup of a future answer is work paid upfront, which fresh random values defeat immediately.
Key result: 31 Machine-Checked Proofs · 0 Time Shortcuts.
Clear math and public price records checked every number.
